items.t: Gov. DeSantis suspends Kissimmee Mayor Jackie Espinosa
items.x: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis suspended Kissimmee Mayor Jackie Espinosa on Friday via an executive order.

items.t: Blue-green algae alert issued for Lake Howell by Department of Health
items.x: The Florida Department of Health in Osceola County (DOH-Seminole) cautions the public about the presence of harmful blue-green algae toxins in Lake Howell.

items.t: FHP arrests ‘Most Wanted Fugitive’ in 2024 Osceola County triple-fatal crash
items.x: Florida Highway Patrol arrested a fugitive wanted for two years in connection with a fatal three-person car crash.

items.t: Orlando’s Savoy gets Instagram back amid wave of Meta suspensions of gay bars
items.x: Longtime Orlando LGBTQ+ bar Savoy regained access to its Instagram, about 10 days after Meta wiped the account following Pride posts.

items.x: Speaking of Gor Gor, the prodigal giant dinosaur will reportedly return to the stage for this current touring run, with a battle to the death with GWAR promised.

items.t: Orlando Maker Faire offers a full weekend of local innovation and creativity
items.x: Returning Nov. 7-8 to the Central Florida Fairgrounds for its 14th year, Maker Faire Orlando gathers artists, engineers, inventors and DIY enthusiasts to show off what they’ve been tinkering with.

items.t: Oviedo’s Bruder Brewery is a handsome pub with up-and-down grub
items.x: Bruder is an award-winning craft brewery with nearly a dozen locations in Colombia. This, its first stateside, exudes a thoughtfulness that suggests formula.

items.t: UK prime minister signals the government will consider an apology for its role in the slave trade
items.x: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham says his government will consider apologizing for the first time for its role in the trans-Atlantic slave trade as it seeks to strengthen relations with nations in Africa and the Caribbean.

items.t: Civilians from war-ravaged Oleshky arrive in Belarus on their way to Ukrainian territory
items.x: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky in Ukraine have arrived in Belarus as part of a major rescue operation.

items.t: Venus Williams loses her doubles match at Guangzhou on the WTA Tour
items.x: Venus Williams has lost in her first WTA Tour semifinal in eight years.

items.t: Congo's Ebola deaths top 5,000 as fear of continent-wide spread mounts
items.x: Deaths in Congo's Ebola outbreak have topped 5,000 as the disease spreads relentlessly.

items.t: Pope Leo receiving teams and fans from US college basketball before their games in Rome
items.x: Pope Leo XIV is preparing to hold a private audience with basketball teams from his alma mater, Villanova, and fellow Catholic university Notre Dame, plus thousands of traveling American fans.

items.t: France heads into third weekend of protests as youth-led rallies sweep Europe
items.x: France is bracing for a third weekend of protests over living costs and education, deploying 70,000 police and gendarmes.

items.t: Other women contacted police about previous incidents with Packers' Josh Jacobs after his arrest
items.x: The Hobart/Lawrence Police Department has released records related to Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs' battery case that noted multiple other women had contacted them to detail allegations against him from years beforehand.
